summary: Implementation plan for the End-to-End Red Flag Procedure System deeply integrated with 5S, Kaizen, and PPSR (8D) modules. Defines the 5-stage lifecycle (Anomaly Detection, 2-Hour Shift Containment, Cross-Module RCA & Escalation, Permanent CAPA with Engineering Updates, and 3-Shift Effectiveness Sign-off), interactive SOP flowchart, SLA escalation matrices, and print-ready Red Flag Action Sheets.
